pipeline: ADE Parse (DPT-2) -> Claude Sonnet answers each question from the parsed markdown/JSON only (no image access)
metric_definition: Case-insensitive exact string match against any ground-truth answer, after stripping whitespace
qa_model: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 per client default; evaluate.py passes claude-sonnet-4-20250514; see notes)
notes: Imported from landing-ai/ade-docvqa-benchmark; not re-run in this repository.
Headline score counts all 5,349 questions. The source repo reports 99.156% after excluding 18 questions LandingAI judged to have questionable ground truth; both are shown.
ANLS is derived, not computed from a full predictions file: the 5,286 exact-match answers each score 1.0, and the 63 listed failures are scored individually in errors.jsonl.
The source repo does not contain a complete predictions file for this run, so predictions.jsonl is not published here. errors.jsonl lists every incorrect answer.
QA model is ambiguous in the source: README and blog say Sonnet 4.5, evaluate.py hard-codes claude-sonnet-4-20250514 (Sonnet 4).
ADE parse ran against the staging endpoint with dpt-2-latest; the exact dated model version was not recorded.
